subject: Claim TM-2026-0102: Report Status and Next Visit Confirmation
body:
Dear Bramfield Motor Works,

We are writing to follow up on claim TM-2026-0102. Could you please provide an update on the status of your report for this claim?

Additionally, we would appreciate confirmation of the date for your next visit in connection with this matter.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this.

Best regards,
Thornfield Mutual Claims Team
